delete.description:
Hide a trip from its owner at once and stop its planning jobs, in one transaction.

Nothing is erased here: the rows stay, marked deleted, until `app.jobs.purge` removes them once the recovery window
(`trip_retention_days`) has passed. Every route reads trips through `owned`, which ignores deleted ones, and the
worker treats a deleted trip as superseded, so nothing can read, edit or publish to it in the meantime.

post.description: Estimate the trip from the stay to a visit and the latest time to leave.
Estimate the trip back to the stay and when the traveler would arrive.
A driving estimate between two places. No schedule, mode choice or booking.

CostInput.title: CostInput
CostInput.description:
Traveler-entered cost; never a supplier quote, booking or charge.

`amount` is a unit price. Total = amount × quantity, multiplied by the
traveler count for per-person costs. Blank means unknown; zero is free.
A cost may link to one activity or one stay (destination stop) by logical
ID. When that item leaves the plan, an estimate goes with it, but a paid
cost stays as an unlinked commitment flagged `link_removed`: removing an
item never implies a refund.

IntercityPlace.title: IntercityPlace
IntercityPlace.description: A retained destination reference, or the trip's own starting point as coordinates.

Lodging.title: Lodging
Lodging.description:
Where the traveler is staying. A record of their choice: never a booking,
availability or price, and never checked against the supplier.

Relocation.title: Relocation
Relocation.description: Move a displaced flexible activity to a remaining day in the route.

StayJourneyInput.title: StayJourneyInput
StayJourneyInput.description: From a traveler-recorded stay (a map point) to a retained place.

StayReturnInput.title: StayReturnInput
StayReturnInput.description: From a retained place back to a traveler-recorded stay.

WishItem.title: WishItem
WishItem.description:
Something the traveler wants to do in a destination, before it has a day or a time. `must` marks the ones that
have to be shown again, with a reason, if they are not scheduled. Nothing here is a booking or a promise.

WishPlace.title: WishPlace
WishPlace.description:
A place the traveler saved from a nearby-places search. A copy of what the search returned, kept so the shortlist
can be shown and the place scheduled later; scheduling it sends only `id`, which the server checks again.
